summary.en: Kogoro, along with Conan, is invited to the wedding of the son of a man who met at a bar he frequents, but suddenly the bride, Sayoko Imamura, says that she doesn't feels well and collapses. She was poisoned.

suspects: Shinpo Yokoyama, Hiroko Nagashima, Alex Harutoshi Kawasu, Gakuto Yamada, Naho Mizuguchi, and Nobuteru Yokoyama
suspectsZh: 横山真帆、长岛弘子、亚历克斯·春俊·川须、山田岳人、水口菜穗与横山信辉
